name: Agent Teams for RM — Account Aggregator Agent
description: Fetches cross-bank financial data for a client via the RBI Account Aggregator (AA) framework. Returns FDs, SIPs, savings accounts, and loans held at other banks (HDFC, Axis, SBI, etc.). Covers 2.2B accounts across 200+ institutions. Runs on AWS Bedrock AgentCore (us-east-1). Auth: AWS SigV4.

skills.name: Get Cross-Bank Financial Profile
skills.description: Returns aggregated financial data across all banks a client uses: FDs, SIPs, savings accounts, loans, and insurance. Requires client consent per RBI AA framework.
examples: Show me Rahul Gupta's complete financial profile across all banks
What FDs does this client hold at other banks?
